name: Inflection pipeline resource-SSOT + debt decommission (Orion -> single-runner chain-full -> ADVI Inflection served)
description: Sub-project 2 of 3 of NFRA_PIPELINE (CTO PRD c925611f0, Andrew-direct 2026-07-02). Walk the Inflection partner pipeline END-TO-END -- first resource (the EventBridge/bronze-complete trigger) through Orion -> bronze -> the single-runner --chain-full -> gold -> platinum -> the ADVI Inflection served surface -> portal -- with /seams + /molecule + /code-review, to establish the ABSOLUTE-TRUTH resource manifest (SSOT), then decommission every deprecated/floating/un-Terraform'd resource (esp. the interim L7 crons + the aggregator once the single 9ET runner is the end-state) and make the inf Terraform rock-solid + applied (live==TF==applied, 0-drift). Includes the L7-consolidation end-state (one event-driven runner on _BRONZE_COMPLETE; interim clock-crons + aggregator decommissioned). ORTHOGONAL to ADVI_ETLFIX/ADVI_INFREF (those = data-correct + un-freeze; this = resource-truth); the /seams+/molecule pass ALSO independently re-verifies the inf ETLFIX work. Firm-scoped (inf; NEVER cross to bd/cot, Rule 13). Method + deliverables + ACs: NFRA_PIPELINE_PRD.md sections 2/4/7.
